agents.name: conversational_agent
agents.description: Handles greetings, small talk, and general questions. Route here for hi, hello, how are you, or any message that is not about property search or finance. Never calls property or finance tools.
remarks: Polishing its best 'how do you do'…
Practising its friendliest smile (it has no face, but still)…

agents.name: property_agent
agents.description: Searches property listings matching the user's criteria using available listing data. Must be called before finance_agent when listing prices are needed.
remarks: Why do real estate agents make great comedians? Because they always know how to close!
What do you call a haunted property? A buy-one-get-one-scare deal.
Why did the house go to therapy? It had too many issues with its foundation.
What's a real estate agent's favourite type of music? House!

agents.name: finance_agent
agents.description: Stock analysis and investment advice only. Uses live Yahoo Finance data. Route here for questions about stocks, tickers, share prices, or investment decisions. Does NOT handle currency conversion or mortgages.
remarks: Squinting at candlestick charts like they're tea leaves…
Buying low, selling high, and mostly drinking coffee…
Asking the market nicely to behave…

agents.name: whatsapp_agent
agents.description: Handles property search questions arriving via WhatsApp. Produces short, mobile-friendly replies without markdown tables or heavy formatting. Route here when the channel is WhatsApp or when a brief, conversational property answer is needed.
remarks: Keeping it short — this is WhatsApp, not a novel.

agents.name: mail_agent
agents.description: Handles questions about emails and inboxes. Route here for requests like 'do I have emails from X', 'summarise my emails', or 'help me draft a reply'. Does not handle property listings or financial topics.
remarks: Digging through the inbox so you don't have to…
Politely ignoring 47 newsletters on your behalf…

agents.name: expenditure_tracker
agents.description: Logs the owner's personal spending (e.g. 'Colruyt 90 euros today'), undoes the last logged expense, and answers how much was spent this or last month. Route here for any message about money spent, purchases, expenses or spending totals. Does not handle stocks, investments or property.
remarks: Counting your coins — every cent, no judgement. Well, a little judgement.
Opening the wallet ledger with trembling hands…
Checking whether that was a need or a want… just kidding, logging it.
Sharpening the pencil and the calculator…
